title: Lost his leg to a landmine. Won India gold anyway.
youtubeTitle: Lost his leg to a landmine. Won India gold anyway.
caption:
Lost his leg to a landmine. Won India gold anyway.

Soman Rana, an Indian Army veteran serving with the Gorkha Rifles, lost a leg in a December 2006 landmine blast while on Line of Control duty in Jammu and Kashmir. He found para-athletics during rehabilitation at Pune's Artificial Limb Centre, later joining the Army Paralympic Node in 2017 and competing at the Tokyo 2020 and Paris 2024 Paralympics. At the 2026 Commonwealth Games in Glasgow, he won gold in the men's F57 shot put with a 13.40m throw, as teammate Shubham Juyal took silver - India's first-ever 1-2 finish in the event at the Commonwealth Games.
